baslik.tr: A pointer to a struct, and ->
baslik.en: A pointer to a struct, and ->

c: printf("(*p).x = %d, p->x = %d (same value, -> is shorthand)\n", (*p).x, p->x);
java: Point(int x, int y) { this.x = x; this.y = y; }
Point p = a;                // p is another reference to the SAME object as a
System.out.println("p.x = " + p.x + " (same object as a, reached through p)");
